newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso rebounds against dollar, ends higher.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso rebounds against dollar, ends higher.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 2.1 to close at 1,022.9, rebounding after its crash Friday, interbank traders said Tuesday.
As trading resumed after the bank holiday Monday to observe the Epiphany, greenbacks from the recent power privatization and petro-dollars continued to flow into the market.
Speculation by banks, coupled with exporters holding back dollar earnings to see if the peso would drop further, pushed it down to 1,029 early in the day.
"The market was pretty volatile today. There was a bit of speculation and exporters were trying to play on that," one trader said.
Dealers reported 409 trades worth a total $193.3 million.
The peso sank to an intraday low of 1,029 and hit an intraday high of 1,021.5 pesos per dollar.
